resources.string: To stop, hold Stop on the screen.
Positions are sent as soon as there is a network.
Leave your phone locked for two minutes.
Ozitrac needs your location to record your run.
Location is off. Turn it on in the settings.
No network: positions are kept and sent later.
Your position is only sent between Start and Stop.
Share live with the people who follow me
Waiting for a good GPS signal (better than 20 m). Stay outside, with the sky in view.
No network: positions will be sent later.
Hold the button for two seconds to stop.
Help asked: the people who follow you are alerted.
%1$d positions are waiting to be sent. They go as soon as there is a network.
Point at the QR code shown on ozimut.com
This code is unknown, already used or expired.
Too many tries. Wait a moment.
Ozimut could not be reached. Check the network.
Some phones stop the GPS when the screen is locked. This test checks yours: start it, lock the phone and leave it locked for two minutes, outdoors or by a window.
Lock your phone now and leave it locked. %1$s left.
Waiting for a first GPS position…
Your phone kept recording while locked: %1$d positions of %2$d.
Your phone stopped recording while locked: %1$d positions of %2$d.
No GPS position was received. Try again outdoors.
A run is being recorded. Try again after it.
Settings › Apps › Ozitrac › Battery: choose « Unrestricted ». Then Settings › Battery › Background usage limits: Ozitrac must not be in « Sleeping apps » or « Deep sleeping apps ».
Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Ozitrac: turn on « Autostart », and under « Battery saver » choose « No restrictions ».
Settings › Battery › App launch › Ozitrac: turn off « Manage automatically », then turn on « Auto-launch », « Secondary launch » and « Run in background ».
Settings › Apps › Ozitrac › Battery usage: allow background activity (« Don\'t optimise »). On Oppo and realme, also turn on « Allow auto launch ».
Settings › Apps › Ozitrac › Battery: choose « Unrestricted » or « Not optimised », and allow background activity.
Nobody follows you yet: your run is kept on this phone.
Your runs go to your Ozimut account.
Kept on this phone only: nobody follows you.
Your run is kept on this phone.
This phone was removed from its Ozimut account.
On ozimut.com, in « GPS tracking », make a code for your account or your child\'s. Scan its QR code, or type its 8 characters. Your runs then go to that account too.
Ozitrac could not reach its server. Check the network and try again.
Your first name for the people you invite: %1$s
You have not given your first name yet.
It is shown to the people who follow you and to those you follow. Nothing else is asked.
Nobody follows you yet. Add someone: they scan your code with their Ozitrac.
%1$s will no longer follow you. Remove?
Your runs are kept on this phone only. Share them or save them as GPX.
Delete this run from this phone? It cannot be undone.
The GPX could not be saved.
Move the map to put the cross at the centre of your zone, and give its radius. If you leave it during a run, the people who follow you are alerted.
Alert the people who follow me when I leave the zone
The radius must be 50 m or more.
Do you have an Ozimut account? Link this phone to it: your runs also go to that account, and the people who follow you there see them.
Linked to the Ozimut account of %1$s.
Your runs also go to that account.
Unlink this phone from Ozimut? Your runs will no longer go to that account.
Ask them to scan this code with Ozitrac on their phone. They will follow your runs live.
This code works once and lasts 24 hours. Make one for each person.
%1$s invites you to follow their runs live with Ozitrac: %2$s
This is not an Ozitrac code.
This code was already used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
This person no longer shares their runs.
Point at the code shown on their phone
You follow nobody yet. Ask someone to show you their code, and scan it.
This person no longer shares their runs with you.
